scripts.dev: npm run db:setup && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@spaceport/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@spaceport/web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate --workspace=@spaceport/api && npm run db:seed --workspace=@spaceport/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@spaceport/shared && npm run build --workspace=@spaceport/api && npm run build --workspace=@spaceport/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@spaceport/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@spaceport/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@spaceport/web
